title: Identification of Key Genes in Acute Liver Failure via Analysis of Programmed Cell Death Patterns.
authors: Liu, Guangli; Wu, Huili; Shi, Wenxiang; Qiu, Chenjie
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过GEO数据挖掘和机器学习识别急性肝衰竭中程序性细胞死亡相关关键基因，虽构建了含转录因子的调控网络，但核心是疾病生物标志物筛选，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制研究，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Acute liver failure (ALF) is a severe condition with high mortality, where programmed cell death (PCD) plays a critical yet not fully understood role. This study aimed to identify key PCD-related genes and explore their potential as biomarkers and therapeutic targets in ALF. METHODS: Three HBV-ALF microarray datasets (GSE14668, GSE38941, GSE62029) from GEO were integrated and analyzed. Differential expression analysis, protein-protein interaction (PPI) network construction, and functional enrichment were performed. Machine learning algorithms (LASSO and random forest) were used to identify hub genes. Immune infiltration was assessed via CIBERSORT and ssGSEA. Regulatory networks involving miRNAs and transcription factors (TFs) were constructed. RESULTS: A total of 109 differentially expressed PCD genes were identified. TIMP1 and IL18 were consistently selected as hub genes by both CytoHubba and machine learning methods. These genes demonstrated high diagnostic accuracy and prognostic value in ALF. Immune infiltration analysis revealed significant associations with macrophage polarization. Functional enrichment linked TIMP1 and IL18 to immune and metabolic pathways. A miRNA-mRNA-TF regulatory network was constructed, with STAT3 identified as a key upstream regulator. CONCLUSION: TIMP1 and IL18 are potential diagnostic biomarkers and candidate therapeutic targets for ALF, closely associated with immune infiltration and PCD processes. These findings provide new insights into the molecular mechanisms of ALF and support the development of targeted therapies.
abstract_zh: 目的：急性肝衰竭（ALF）是一种高死亡率的严重疾病，其中程序性细胞死亡（PCD）发挥关键但尚未完全阐明的作用。本研究旨在识别关键的PCD相关基因，并探讨其作为ALF生物标志物和治疗靶点的潜力。方法：整合并分析了来自GEO的三个HBV-ALF微阵列数据集（GSE14668、GSE38941、GSE62029）。进行了差异表达分析、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络构建和功能富集分析。使用机器学习算法（LASSO和随机森林）识别核心基因。通过CIBERSORT和ssGSEA评估免疫浸润。构建了涉及miRNA和转录因子（TFs）的调控网络。结果：共鉴定出109个差异表达的PCD基因。TIMP1和IL18被CytoHubba和机器学习方法一致选为核心基因。这些基因在ALF中显示出高诊断准确性和预后价值。免疫浸润分析揭示了与巨噬细胞极化的显著关联。功能富集将TIMP1和IL18与免疫和代谢通路联系起来。构建了miRNA-mRNA-TF调控网络，其中STAT3被确定为关键上游调控因子。结论：TIMP1和IL18是ALF的潜在诊断生物标志物和候选治疗靶点，与免疫浸润和PCD过程密切相关。这些发现为ALF的分子机制提供了新见解，并支持靶向治疗的发展。
